answer: Payment-instrument gating keeps clone farming uneconomical. Any new identity must clear a one-time five-dollar authorization on a bank card no other identity has ever used. The rule is crystal clear - one card, one identity - and when two names map to one instrument, each fake's 10,000 POA bond burns at once. A hundred clones thus front five hundred dollars plus a million POA before earning anything, while an honest operator queues once on the registry's terrace and clears the admission summit free.
